cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
s: Ensure grout joints and tile surfaces are thoroughly dry, clean, free from dirt, dust, grease, oil, wax and other contaminants.

cl.x: Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.

s: Consumption: Approximately 6-10m2/L (depending upon surface porosity and site conditions)
r: Approximately 6-10m2/L (depending upon surface porosity and site conditions)

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application
cl.l: 1. Apply using a sponge, brush or spray gun. 2. Allow 5-10 minutes for the sealer to penetrate the surface, then wipe off excess with a damp sponge. 3. Allow the sealer to cure for 24 hours prior to returning the area to service.
s: Note: If only sealing grout joints of porous ceramic or terracotta tiles, ensure clean up method is pre-tested. It may be necessary to mask the joints

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Tools
cl.x: Excess Davco® Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer and tools can be cleaned up with Mineral Turpentine while the product is still wet / prior to drying.

s: Test product in an inconspicuous area first
Do not flood the floor with Davco® Sanitized Tile & Grout Sealer. Apply only in small sections and clean up the area before moving on
Do not allow excess sealer to dry on the surface of the tiles as it will leave a white residue
For other uses not mentioned in these instructions, please contact Sika Australia
